question: The headquarters of the World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) is located at:
solution:
The correct answer id __**Madrid, Spain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) was **established in 1975.**
 
• It evolved from the **International Union of Official Travel Organizations (IUOTO)**, which was formed in 1925.
 
• In 2003, the UNWTO became a specialized agency of the** United Nations**. 
 
• The UNWTO established** World Tourism Day, **celebrated annually on **September 27 since 1980**,
